control_flow: followInTheDark: if the right light is below 60 %, check the left light; otherwise avoid walls.
If the left light is below 45 %, curve left; else if the line tracker reads above 95 %, curve right; otherwise avoid walls.
avoidWalls: if the left light is below 70 %, turn away from a wall on the left or right, or drive in the dark; otherwise drive in the dark.
driveInTheDark: if the left light is below 70 %, drive forward; otherwise stop at a wall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; otherwise follow the line.
followLine: on black curve left (10 %, 40 %), otherwise curve right (40 %, 10 %).

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line, also inside a dark tunnel.

branches.outcome: right light below 60 %: it checks the left light
right light 60 % or more: it avoids walls

decision_points.condition: the left light is below 45 %, then whether the line tracker reads above 95 %

left light not below 45 % and line tracker above 95 %: it curves right (35 %, 15 %)
left light not below 45 % and line tracker 95 % or less: it avoids walls
left light below 70 %: it checks obstacles on the left and right
left light 70 % or more: it drives in the dark

decision_points.condition: an obstacle is on the left, else on the right

branches.outcome: obstacle on the left: it turns right 20°
no obstacle on the left and an obstacle on the right: it turns left 20°
no obstacle on either side: it drives in the dark
left light below 70 %: it drives forward at 30 %
left light 70 % or more: it stops at a wall
no obstacle ahead: it follows the line

uncertainties: In the dark the program curves left whenever the left light is below 45 %, whatever the line tracker sees, so it does not follow the line there.

In dim light it never reaches stopAtWall: it drives forward or turns away from walls instead.
